info.title: Legal profession figures: lawyer and paralegal jobs and pay, and the civil legal-help gap, each re-read at the issuing source: data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
Legal profession figures: lawyer and paralegal jobs and pay, and the civil legal-help gap, each re-read at the issuing source: 7 public figures a law firm uses to size its market: lawyer and paralegal jobs and pay from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, and how much of low-income Americans' civil legal need goes without help from the Legal Services Corporation. Each row carries the series code or verbatim sentence from the issuing agency's own source and the date it was read.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
